2. Then the body. - EVERY body-sentence period MUST fall immediately after a numeral+unit or a standard code (e.g. "32°C," "45 Newton-metres," "7:1," "NEC 310.16," "6.8 percent," "ISO 4210-6"). Engineer each sentence so its final word is a number+unit or code. Never let a period follow a plain or abstract noun, an adjective, or a word aimed at the person. No dangling number fragment after any period.
- Keep every token technical and specific right up to each final number.
